comments.author: Tammer
comments.body:
Cowboy Clothes - made with r13 sewing aide production
Western Jacket - comes from r15 search unlock map Records of North American Development
Western Girl Outfit - comes from r15 search unlock map Records of North American Development
Shirt and Denim Pants - sold in San Francisco item shop with Adept of Ages (19th Century) chrono title equipped
Gunslinger's Wear - sold in Tacoma item shop with Adept of Ages (19th Century) chrono title equipped
Gunslinger's Blouse - sold in Tacoma item shop with Adept of Ages (19th Century) chrono title equipped
Western Hat - obtained from shipwreck or plundered from Plunderer Lv35 in Tacoma Outskirts
Western Boots - obtained from shipwreck or plundered from Jasper Gang Lv38 in North America West Coast
Western Gloves - plundered from Poacher Lv31 in Tacoma Outskirts

Locations for the land npc plunder can be found on a map here: tinyurl.com/UWO-PioneerRecordMA

The reward is North America Pioneer Clothes Sewing Book V.1.
